solutions.title: Pairwise assign
solutions.strategy: Compare each ungrouped string with later strings using cyclic differences.

timeComplexity.explanation: Pairs can compare up to L characters.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Visited flags and output groups are stored.

solutions.title: Normalized key
solutions.strategy: Build a canonical key from character offsets relative to the first char.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each string contributes one key built from its characters.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Keys and output groups store the input strings.
